description: Line and load data for the modified 69-bus distribution system and Shandong Power Grid is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Wanjun Huang, Weiye Zheng. This file provides the line and load data of modified 69-bus distribution system and a practical large-scale distribution system from Shandong Power Grid. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 429151 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
